name: KSL
recent: KSL 在2026年9月完成股息再投资计划（DRP），发行约3564万新股，使总股本增至约11.29亿股。11月公布的第三季业绩显示净利按年微升3%至1.049亿令吉，九个月产业销售超越2025年全年纪录。同期，子公司以1.81亿令吉出售Tebrau永久地契地块。
notable: 完成股息再投资计划，发行35,638,678股新股，并于2026年9月7日上市。
第三季净利按年上升3%至1.049亿令吉，九个月产业销售超越2025年全年纪录。
子公司以1.81亿令吉出售Tebrau永久地契地块。
risks: 股息再投资计划发行新股，导致股本扩大，可能对每股盈利造成摊薄。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度（Q2 FY2026）营收为3.8097亿令吉，按季增长32.7%，按年增长4.5%；净利为1.1573亿令吉，按季增长77.2%，按年增长2.4%；净利率为30.4%，高于上一季度的22.7%。

recent_en: KSL completed its Dividend Reinvestment Plan (DRP) in September 2026, issuing about 35.64 million new shares and enlarging total share base to approximately 1.129 billion shares. Third-quarter results announced in November showed net profit up 3% year-on-year to RM104.9 million, with nine-month property sales surpassing the 2025 full-year record. Meanwhile, subsidiaries sold freehold Tebrau plots for RM181 million.
notable_en: Completed Dividend Reinvestment Plan with 35,638,678 new shares issued and listed on 7 September 2026.
Third-quarter net profit rose 3% year-on-year to RM104.9 million; nine-month property sales surpassed the 2025 full-year record.
Subsidiaries sold freehold Tebrau plots for RM181 million.
risks_en: The Dividend Reinvestment Plan issued new shares, enlarging the share base and potentially diluting earnings per share.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026 (Q2 FY2026), revenue was RM380.97 million, up 32.7% QoQ and 4.5% YoY; net income was RM115.73 million, up 77.2% QoQ and 2.4% YoY; net margin was 30.4%, higher than 22.7% in the previous quarter.
